units.source_text: 老乳母听了她的话也很欢喜，说道：“你说的是。

en.t: The old nurse was delighted to hear her words and said, "You are right.

units.source_text: 我告诉你：这个如花如玉的人儿，险些儿埋没在穷乡僻壤了！

en.t: Let me tell you: this flowerlike, jewel-like young lady nearly wasted away in a remote backwater!

units.source_text: 我们又是忧虑，又是悲伤，便舍弃了家园财物，

en.t: We were full of worry and grief, so we abandoned our home and possessions,

units.source_text: 抛弃了亲生子女，逃回到这他乡一般的京都来。

en.t: left even our own children behind, and fled back here to Kyoto, which felt like a foreign land.
Please help raise her up as soon as you can.

units.source_text: 你在贵人家里供职，自然有机会遇见内大臣。

en.t: Since you serve in a noble household, you will naturally have chances to meet the Minister of the Center.

units.source_text: 请你想个办法，通知她父亲，请他收容了这个亲生女儿。”

en.t: Please find some way to inform her father and ask him to take in this daughter of his own blood."

units.source_text: 玉鬘听了，红晕满颊，便背转身去。

en.t: Tamakazura heard this, blushed deeply across her cheeks, and turned her back.

units.source_text: 我虽然身份卑微，也常得接近源氏大臣。

en.t: Though my rank is humble, I often have the chance to be near Minister Genji.

units.source_text: 有时我乘机说起：‘我家夫人所生的小女公子，现在不知怎么样了。’

en.t: Sometimes, when the moment is right, I mention, 'I wonder what has become of the little young lady born to my mistress.'

units.source_text: 大臣说：‘我也想设法寻找她呢。

en.t: The minister said, 'I too want to find some way to search for her.

units.source_text: 你倘听到消息，就告诉我。’”

en.t: If you should hear any news, tell me.'"

units.source_text: 乳母说：“源氏太政大臣固然贤明，

en.t: The nurse said, "The Grand Minister Genji is certainly wise,

units.source_text: 但他家里有许多身份高贵的夫人，小姐不宜加入。

en.t: but there are many high-ranking ladies in his household, and it would not be fitting for the young lady to join them.

units.source_text: 还不如告知她的生身父亲内大臣为是。”

en.t: It would be better instead to inform her true father, the Minister of the Center."
